answer.reason: The verses tell of Esau's sale of his birthright, the loss of Isaac's blessing to Jacob, and his reconciliation with Jacob, which are the events he is known for.

clauses.english: sold his birthright to Jacob for bread and lentil pottage
lost his father's blessing when Jacob received it by deceit
clauses.quote: Thy brother came with subtilty, and hath taken away thy blessing.

clauses.english: ran to meet Jacob on his return and embraced him
clauses.quote: And Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck, and kissed him

doubts: GEN 27:41 (Esau's hatred of Jacob and plan to kill him) was left out as intent, not an event.
The Esau of the later prophets (JER 49, OBA, MAL) and ROM 9:13 stands for Edom, so those verses were not used.
